name: Cedar Crest Golf Course
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass. Gold, Silver and Ruby play to par 71 (#10 a 456-yd par 5); the Tournament and Black tees play #10 as a par 4 (par 70, as OpenStreetMap tags it) and the card gives no hole yardages for them, so they are left out. Men's ratings.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery (measured by fitting all bunkers to the sand); every point is moved by it.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course (practice greens).
